---
title: "Overall survival — imputation"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(mice)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

# The passive methods below call derive_ecog_binary() and derive_mgps(), so
# they must exist in the global environment when mice() runs.
source(here("R", "covariates.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "02-overall-survival", "01-main", "results")
imputation_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "imputations")
dir.create(imputation_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_main)
imputation_paths <- file.path(
  imputation_dir,
  sprintf("imputation-%02d.rds", indices)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: build-imputation-data
#| include: false

# Gender is stored as text; mice treats a character column as constant and
# drops it from the imputation models, so it enters as a factor.
imputation_data <- read_parquet(file.path(results_dir, "prepared.parquet")) |>
  mutate(
    ecog_fstcnt = ordered(ecog_fstcnt, levels = 0:4),
    gender = factor(gender)
  ) |>
  as.data.frame()

imputation_data$na_est <- nelsonaalen(
  imputation_data,
  timevar = survival_time_days,
  statusvar = event_death
)

# Passive variables last, so they update after their sources in each iteration.
imputation_data <- imputation_data |>
  relocate(ecog_binary, mgps, .after = last_col())
```

```{r}
#| label: imputation-model
#| include: false

methods <- make.method(imputation_data)
methods[c("id", "tx", "survival_time_days", "event_death", "na_est")] <- ""
methods["ecog_fstcnt"] <- "polr"
methods["ecog_binary"] <- "~I(derive_ecog_binary(ecog_fstcnt))"
methods["mgps"] <- "~I(derive_mgps(albumin, c_reactive_protein))"

predictors <- make.predictorMatrix(imputation_data)
predictors[c("id", "tx", "survival_time_days", "event_death", "na_est"), ] <- 0
predictors[, c("id", "survival_time_days", "ecog_binary", "mgps")] <- 0
```

```{r}
#| label: impute-os
#| include: false

for (index in indices) {
  if (file.exists(imputation_paths[[index]])) next

  imputation <- mice(
    imputation_data,
    method = methods,
    predictorMatrix = predictors,
    m = 1,
    maxit = config$imputation$maxit,
    donors = config$imputation$donors,
    seed = config$seeds$imputation + (index - 1) * 1000,
    printFlag = FALSE
  )
  saveRDS(imputation, imputation_paths[[index]], compress = "xz")
}

# The per-index runs share data, methods and predictors, so they can be
# combined into one mids object for the convergence and distribution plots.
imputation <- imputation_paths |>
  map(readRDS) |>
  reduce(ibind)
```

## Convergence

```{r}
#| label: fig-os-imputation-traces
#| fig-cap: "MICE trace plots for the imputed overall-survival variables: mean and standard deviation of the imputed values, one line per completed dataset"

#| echo: false

plot_mice_traces(mice_chain_stats(imputation))
```

## Observed and imputed distributions

```{r}
#| label: fig-os-imputation-distributions-continuous
#| fig-cap: "Observed (black) and imputed (pink, one line per completed dataset) distributions of the laboratory variables"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
#| echo: false

lab_values <- imputed_values(
  imputation,
  c(
    Albumin = "albumin",
    Bilirubin = "bilirubin",
    CRP = "c_reactive_protein",
    LDH = "lactate_dehydrogenase"
  )
)

plot_imputed_densities(lab_values$observed, lab_values$imputed)
```
